extra.final_summary:
Data quality issues found and fixed:
- Category label variants with leading/trailing spaces (rows 13, 28, 37) normalized to allowed labels.
- Price column contained text numbers like $300.00; cast to numeric.
- Quantity out of range: row 40 had Quantity -6, violating min 1 rule; row excluded.
- Exact duplicate row (row 31) removed to avoid double counting.

After cleaning, 46 orders remain. Order counts by Category:
- Accessories: 9
- Electronics: 11
- Furniture: 14
- Office Supplies: 12

Caveats: One invalid order was excluded due to negative quantity; duplicate removed.
